notes.title: Introducing Dice × Dice — A Dicebuilder Roguelike
notes.notes:
[p]Hi, I'm Roman—a developer of [b]Dice × Dice[/b]: a strategic roguelike where you rewrite dice rules, forge wild combos, and outsmart adaptive bosses.[/p][p align="start"]Inspired by [b]Slay the Spire[/b] and [b]Balatro[/b], the game aims to deliver a JoJo-style bizarre adventure on steroids — stylish, chaotic, and unforgettable.
[/p][p align="start"]This is just the beginning — more updates are coming soon. [/p][p][/p][p][i][b]Wishlist Dice × Dice now and join us on this journey![/b][/i][/p]
